column2: 0.10%/yr). GAP-FREE from 1953-04: H.15 suspended the 20-year constant maturity between 1987-01 and 1993-09 and the 30-year point publishes straight through
column3: so the long yield this is priced off has no hole and neither does this series. The BOND is 20-year throughout (the maturity of the published long-term government bond record
column4: and the neighbourhood of what VUSTX holds); the CURVE POINT it is discounted at is the long one
column5: i.e. the 30-year par yield from 1977-02 and the 20-year point mapped onto it before
column6: which differs from the published 20-year point by +0.2124 -0.0362*y20 (about +0.07 pt at a 4%/yr yield
column7: -0.22 pt at 12%) and whose moves are 0.964 as large. Month-end
column8: one point per calendar month; the pre-1962 head is a month-AVERAGE yield carried at its month-end label
column9: the only cadence H.15 published then. January 1973 is compounded in two pieces around the 1973-01-04 definitional break of the 20-year point
column10: so it carries the real moves on each side of it and not the break itself. Proxy behind VUSTX.
